definitions.explanation: The act or state of going upward.
A train heading toward a major city (especially Tokyo).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上|のぼ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧。
examples.english: The climb on this road is steep.

examples.japanese: {上|のぼ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいる→込む：00719_komu⟧。
⟦{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}→上り坂：16376_noborizaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漕|こ}ぐ→漕ぐ：04264_kogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to pedal a bicycle uphill.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{上|のぼ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}くて→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: This uphill stretch is long and tiring.

examples.japanese: {上|のぼ}り⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{下|くだ}り→下り：02659_kudari⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{所要|しょよう}{時間|じかん}→所要時間：26566_shoyoujikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The time needed differs between going up and coming down.

examples.japanese: {上|のぼ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧。
examples.english: The inbound Shinkansen is crowded in the morning.

notes:
{上|のぼ}り is the noun form derived from the verb ⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧ (to climb, to go up).

TRAIN TERMINOLOGY:
In Japanese railway, {上|のぼ}り and ⟦{下|くだ}り→下り：02659_kudari⟧ indicate direction relative to major cities:
- {上|のぼ}り: toward Tokyo (or the major terminus)
- ⟦{下|くだ}り→下り：02659_kudari⟧: away from Tokyo (or the major terminus)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}→上り坂：16376_noborizaka⟧ (uphill slope)
- {上|のぼ}り{線|せん} (inbound line/track)
- {上|のぼ}り⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧ (up-train)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{下|くだ}り→下り：02659_kudari⟧ (descent; down-train)
